title: Numerical modeling to enhance the efficiency of experimentally fabricated Sb2Se3-based solar cell
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2873-2903
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04411A, Paper

The promising efficiency of 24.86% with VOC = 0.94 V, JSC = 31.98 mA cm−2, and FF = 83.09% is obtained for the proposed FTO/SnS2/Sb2Se3/SnS/Au photovoltaic structure with SnS BSF layer at thickness of 0.2 µm and doping of 1020 cm−3.
